steps.command:
python3 - <<'EOF'
import json, urllib.request

def post(payload, raw=False):
    data = payload if isinstance(payload, (bytes, str)) else json.dumps(payload).encode()
    req = urllib.request.Request("http://127.0.0.1:5000/sentiment", data=data,
                                 headers={"Content-Type": "application/json"}, method="POST")
    try:
        with urllib.request.urlopen(req) as r:
            return r.status, json.loads(r.read())
    except urllib.error.HTTPError as e:
        return e.code, json.loads(e.read())

print("positive:", post({"text": "I absolutely loved this movie, it was wonderful!"}))
print("negative:", post({"text": "This was terrible and I hated every minute of it."}))
print("missing text:", post({}))
print("non-string text:", post({"text": 123}))
print("empty text:", post({"text": "   "}))
print("no json body:", post("not json", raw=True))
EOF

path = snapshot_download(MODEL_ID, revision="714eb0fa89d2f80546fda750413ed43d93601a13", local_dir=LOCAL_DIR)
print("Downloaded model to:", path)
